title: Three-point ordered convolution-square classification
abstract: For three-element finite supports S and T in any abelian group, equality of all labelled coefficients of their ordered additive convolution squares is equivalent to a translation by an element annihilated by doubling, or to the explicit exceptional paired shape in the statement. Diagonal pairs are included. The full proof development is contained in this snapshot. This is an adaptation of an existing public Couret formalization; mathematical novelty and independent human review are not established.
